title: How desirable is alignment between LLMs and linguistically diverse human users?

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and synthesizing psycholinguistic literature on multilingual language processing, L1/L2 differences, and foreign accent comprehension to evaluate the necessity and implications of LLMs linguistically aligning with diverse users.

Evaluating existing research on age-related cognitive changes in language production and processing (e.g., semantic interpretation speed, pronoun usage) to discuss how LLM adaptation could facilitate communication for older adults.

Reviewing prior studies on gender differences in language use (e.g., word choice, expressiveness) and the impact of gender stereotypes on language processing to assess the desirability of gender-aligned LLM behavior.

Discussing recent external evaluations (e.g., using the World Views Survey) that test how LLMs align with specific cultural values, socioeconomic classes, and geographic regions based on the prompting language.
